integrity: Finite theorem reproduced by exhaustive face and automorphism enumeration and a complete acyclic discrete-Morse matching; computation verified in the supplied standalone program. Independent external review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact rational automorphism character for the single sixteen-vertex four-cube; no claim for larger hypercubes, integral equivariant lattices, or equivariant homotopy types. The directly related Jonsson paper was accessible only at abstract level; unindexed equivalent treatments cannot be excluded.
title: Complete hyperoctahedral homology character of the four-cube independence complex
